permit.quote: Unless you have elected to opt-out of providing your geographic location information, the Applications may use and store information related to the geographic location of your device and combine this information with other Personal Information to provide certain services, whether or not the Application is active.

prohibit.quote: We do not collect Personal Information.

conflicts.situation: A user who has not opted out of location uses the app, which uses and stores the device's geographic location.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines geographic location as Personal Information, so storing it is collecting Personal Information. No exception qualifies the flat denial of collection.

permit.quote: Unless you have elected to opt-out of providing your geographic location information, the Applications may use and store information related to the geographic location of your device and combine this information with other Personal Information to provide certain services, whether or not the Application is active.

prohibit.quote: Since we do not collect Personal Information, we may not use your Personal Information in any way.

conflicts.situation: A user who has not opted out of location uses the app, which uses device geolocation to provide services.
conflicts.reason: Geolocation is defined as Personal Information and the app may use it, while s3 says Personal Information is not used in any way. No carve-out or precedence is given.

permit.quote: Unless you have elected to opt-out of providing your geographic location information, the Applications may use and store information related to the geographic location of your device and combine this information with other Personal Information to provide certain services, whether or not the Application is active.

prohibit.quote: We do not store Personal Information and therefore we do not disclose your Personal Information

conflicts.situation: A user who has not opted out of location uses the app, which stores the device's geographic location.
conflicts.reason: The app may store geolocation, which the policy defines as Personal Information, while s4 states Personal Information is not stored. The policy does not say which statement governs.

permit.quote: Your Personal Information may be stored and processed in any country where we have facilities

prohibit.quote: We do not store Personal Information and therefore we do not disclose your Personal Information

conflicts.situation: Any user of the app whose information the company holds and processes.
conflicts.reason: s10 says Personal Information may be stored in any country with company facilities, while s4 says no Personal Information is stored. No region or user group separates the two.

permit.quote: Session and Usage Data includes information relating to the connection request, server communication and data sharing, including network measurements, quality of service, and date, time and location of the bump.

prohibit.quote: We do not collect Personal Information.

conflicts.situation: A user's session data, including the location of a connection event, is collected as Session and Usage Data.
conflicts.reason: Session data includes location, but the policy lists location information as Personal Information, which it says it never collects. The policy labels session data non-personal without reconciling the two definitions.

permit.quote: However, you will still receive ads based on criteria such as the Game you are playing, the content of that Game, or the region in which your device is located.

prohibit.quote: You should note that if you opt out of receiving targeted advertising, you will still see advertising and you will see advertising for King products, but that advertising will not be targeted using your personal information.

conflicts.situation: A player who opted out of targeted advertising is shown ads chosen by the region where the device is located.
conflicts.reason: The policy treats state or country level device location as personal information, yet says ads after opt-out use device region while also not using personal information. No statement reconciles these.

permit.quote: When you play our Games or use our other Services, identifiers and other information from your device is collected and shared with our advertising partners to enable the technical delivery of ads to your device.

prohibit.quote: If you opt out of the ‘sale or sharing’ of your information, we will not sell your information, including to our advertising partners, or share your information with them.

conflicts.situation: A California player who opted out of sale or sharing keeps playing and still receives ads delivered by advertising partners.
conflicts.reason: s8 shares device identifiers with advertising partners whenever a game is played, while s10 says no information is shared with them after opt-out. The policy does not say whether ad delivery sharing is exempt.

permit.quote: To help you receive more useful and relevant advertisements on other websites and services and to measure the effectiveness of advertising, CamScanner shares limited personal data with our advertising partners.

prohibit.quote: We share Non-Identifying Information (including the advertising identifier currently associated with your device) and other aggregated information that does not include personal information with advertisement providers.

conflicts.situation: CamScanner shares cookie identifiers or a hashed email of a user with an advertising partner such as Google for ad targeting.
conflicts.reason: s9 says sharing is limited to listed situations and that ad providers receive information without personal information. s14 says personal data goes to advertising partners. No precedence or exception is stated.

permit.quote: Where necessary, CamScanner may also retain records of our communications with you and related logs (for example, your account-closure log) for dispute resolution.

prohibit.quote: Until you request deletion of the data or delete your account, whichever is earlier.

conflicts.situation: An EEA user deletes the account after contacting customer service, and CamScanner holds the customer-service communication records.
conflicts.reason: s5 says customer-service records, kept for dispute resolution, are retained only until account deletion. s20 says communication records may be retained after closure for dispute resolution. The policy does not say which governs.

permit.quote: In addition, we may retain records to prevent fraud and ensure security, for example in the event of abuse of our Services or violation of our terms.

prohibit.quote: Until you request deletion of the data or delete your account, whichever is earlier.

conflicts.situation: An EEA user deletes the account, and CamScanner holds device data collected for fraud prevention and account security.
conflicts.reason: s5 limits retention of device data used for fraud prevention and security to account deletion. s21 permits keeping records for fraud prevention after closure. No statement of precedence links the two.
